author: BerrySmooothie
body:
Hello!
So I've been noticing that on Nebula, Gladiator is a VERY popular map which makes the number of people go overboard and not many people who want to play won't have much of a chance.

My Suggestion:

- Expand the player amount to about 30-40?
- Expand the map a little so it doesn't get too hectic
- AND ALSO make sure to fix the 591, 592, 593 seconds left thing.

P.S. I also think this problem goes the same for Senex I. 
                    Please do have a think about it!

Let me know what you think should happen and why.
EITHER:
- Not change it at all
- Expand it a bit
- YES DEFINITELY 

Alicia_Nirui123 xx
